lessons.title: Health and Wellbeing — A1
lessons.learn: Use short Marathi sentences for basic recognition and respectful interaction. Marathi is normally subject–object–verb and marks relationships with endings or postpositions. Apply the skill to health & doctor with age-appropriate, respectful forms.

grammar.title: Health and Wellbeing structures
grammar.explain: Use short Marathi sentences for basic recognition and respectful interaction. Marathi is normally subject–object–verb and marks relationships with endings or postpositions. Marathi verbs and adjectives may show gender and number, while case relations and politeness shape natural word choice.
grammar.pattern: context + marked participants + object/complement + finite verb
mistakes: Do not copy English word order or ignore gender, number, and respectful तुम्ही forms in formal interaction.

pronunciation.t: Marathi contrasts short and long vowel qualities.
pronunciation.tip: Listen to whole words and keep each syllable clear.
Curl the tongue tip back briefly.
Curl the tongue back while letting air pass at the sides.
Let the following sound guide the nasal pronunciation.

alphabet.title: Marathi Devanagari Foundations
alphabet.explain: The SAME script as Hindi — if you read Hindi, you can sound out Marathi on day one. Only two surprises wait: ळ (retroflex L, unknown in Hindi) and a few spelling habits of its own.

counting.title: Marathi Numbers
counting.explain: Marathi counts directly — number + noun, no classifier words:
rules: Learn one to twenty as complete forms.
A numeral normally comes before the noun it counts.
